purpose_context: Kent moved his private growth-work folder to a separate Obsidian vault that office2 never joins, so the in-repo 'never touch _private' apparatus (a lint validator + CI step + workspace-validator invariants + a red-line in every agent prompt + governance/design/runbook docs) now protects a directory that is not present. This mission removes that folder-specific apparatus, generalizes the general privacy hygiene (redact vault paths from alerts; refuse writes to arbitrary vault paths), and reframes the graph-ingest privacy model to 'verify not present'.
purpose_tldr: Retire the obsolete in-repo guards for the _private folder (now a laptop/phone-only vault office2 never syncs), keeping and generalizing the still-valuable vault-path hygiene.
